<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead">
Repo: /home/phili/tools/cavecrew-mcp. One file: cave/skills.js. Three related chop bugs, ground-truth diagnosed from live runs (bot at camp, 44 real grove logs 12 blocks away, chopped:0):

BUG B (core): chopTrees main loop (~line 1117+): `maxIterations = count * 4 + 20`; every quarantine/no-go skip consumes one iteration. Camp has ~30 protected structural logs within maxDistance of camp positions, so with count:4 (36 iterations) the budget burns entirely on skips before findBlock ever reaches a legit tree farther out. FIX: skips must not consume the chop budget. Move the `iterations++` so it only counts real chop ATTEMPTS, not skips — the loop stays bounded because every skip adds a NEW key to skippedKeys (findBlock matcher excludes skipped keys, finite log blocks in range). Add a separate hard safety cap on total loop passes (e.g. 500) so a pathological matcher can never spin forever; hitting it aborts with a clear error.

BUG A: ensureTool(bot,{kind:'axe'},ctx) runs BEFORE the loop (~line 1106) and can physically WALK the bot to camp (depot withdraw + crafting table), so the loop then searches from camp instead of where the driver positioned the bot. FIX: capture `const chopOrigin = bot.entity.position.clone()` at task start, and after ensureTool completes, if bot moved more than ~8 blocks from chopOrigin, goto back to chopOrigin (reuse whatever internal goto helper chopTrees/skills.js already uses — grep for the module's own goto/moveTo helper, do NOT hand-roll pathfinding) before entering the loop. If the return-goto fails, log a warn and continue from current position (degraded, not fatal).

BUG C: ensureTool with kind 'axe' produced a wooden_PICKAXE (live evidence: bot asked for axe, ended with wooden_pickaxe + planks x3 + stick x2 — exact leftovers of one pickaxe craft from 2 logs). Find the craft-chain code ensureTool uses (grep craftToolChain / ensureTool in skills.js), trace how the target tool name is derived from kind, find why 'axe' resolves to a pickaxe recipe (hardcoded name? shared default? wrong lookup key?), and fix so kind:'axe' crafts wooden_axe. Report the exact cause you found.

VERIFY: node --check cave/skills.js. Do not touch other files. Report: per-bug root cause + fix location (file:line), syntax result. Caveman style, exact refs.
</teammate-message>

3 chop bugs fixed, cave/skills.js only.

BUG B (budget burn) — root confirm: `iterations++` sat at top of while loop (old line 1119), so camp-quarantine skip, no-go skip, non-tree skip each ate one of `count*4+20` slots before findBlock ever got past camp.
Fix: skip checks (camp quarantine ~1198, no-go zone ~1209, natural-tree ~1215) now `continue` WITHOUT touching iterations. `iterations++` moved to line 1224, right after last skip check, right before real attempt (goto+dig try block). Added `HARD_LOOP_CAP=500` on total loop passes (`loopPasses`, line ~1157-1166) — throws clear error if matcher pathologically spins, budget itself stays finite anyway cuz skippedKeys grows every pass.

BUG A (ensureTool camp-walk) — confirmed ensureTool(axe) at old line 1106 runs before loop, can walk bot to camp via depot/table.
Fix: `chopOrigin = bot.entity.position.clone()` captured line 1102, before ensureTool call. After ensureTool, if `distanceTo(chopOrigin) > 8`, reuse existing `gotoLoop` + `goals.GoalNear` (same helper branchMine already uses at line ~3602) to walk back. Goto failure = warn + continue from current pos, NOT fatal (matches your spec, differs from branchMine's hard-fail — chop tolerates degraded start, trunk-dig doesn't). Lines 1113-1140.

BUG C (axe->pickaxe) — root cause is NOT a name/lookup bug. Traced craftWithTable calls: 'wooden_pickaxe'/'wooden_axe'/stone_axe|stone_pickaxe names all correctly derived from `kind`, no hardcode. Real cause: `ensurePlanksAndSticks()` (old line 2330) enforces hard floor `planks.count < 5` on EVERY call, but craftToolChain calls it once per tool crafted in the SAME chain run (bootstrap pickaxe first, then requested tool). Math: 2 logs->8 planks, stick craft eats 2->6 planks/4 sticks, wooden_pickaxe eats 3+2->leaves EXACTLY 3 planks+2 sticks (matches your live evidence exactly). That's already enough for wooden_axe (needs 3+2) but the axe-branch's ensurePlanksAndSticks call re-checks against the 5-floor, sees 3<5, tries ensureLogs() for more (which can itself starve if no logs left in reach / nested into Bug B's chopTrees fallback), fails, throws 'could not gather any logs for planks' — chain aborts, axe craft never attempted, only bootstrap pickaxe survives.
Fix: split floor into PLANK_MIN=3 (hard requirement, gates the throw) vs PLANK_BUFFER=5 (soft top-up target, only attempted if a log is already on hand or count is below MIN). Now: has-enough-for-one-more-tool (>=3) skips the gather attempt entirely and proceeds to craft. Bare-case (0 planks, 0 logs) still throws same as before — no regression on UngaBunga's original bare-bootstrap fix. Lines 2330-2361ish (function ensurePlanksAndSticks).
